findings.evidence: The privacy policy mentions collecting IP addresses and device IDs but does not specify the purpose for which this data is used. The policy states, 'We may collect information regarding your use of our software, applications and/or services, including information about the duration of your use, the features you use and your interactions with other users of the software, applications and/or services. We may collect information regarding the device you use to access the software, applications and/or services, including (where applicable) its model, operating system, screen resolution and other technical information.' However, it does not state the specific purpose for which this data is used.
